queries.name: jambonz.cloud/Call by call_sid
queries.queryString:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, level, msg, @message
| filter @message like "{{call_sid}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000

queries.name: jambonz.cloud/SBC call by SIP Call-ID

parameters.name: sip_callid
parameters.description: SIP Call-ID of the carrier leg (inbound and outbound apps log on this, not call_sid)

queries.queryString:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, level, msg, @message
| filter @message like "{{sip_callid}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000

queries.name: jambonz.cloud/Calls for an account

parameters.name: account_sid
parameters.description: account_sid (uuid); keep the time range tight

queries.queryString:
filter @message like "{{account_sid}}"
| stats min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen, count(*) as lines by callSid
| sort first_seen desc
| limit 1000

queries.name: jambonz.cloud/Calls to or from a number

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: digits only, no leading + (logs carry 14795009140, not +14795009140)

queries.queryString:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, callSid, callId, msg
| filter @message like "{{number}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000
